mutations.name: ack-memory-or-error
mutations.why: A volatile receiver or failed save cannot take durable source responsibility.

mutations.name: forget-disk-receiver-on-crash
mutations.why: After source ACK, receiver restart must retain the accepted journal responsibility.

mutations.name: fresh-receiver-entry-on-replay
mutations.why: A reply lost after durable acceptance cannot create a second receiver effect.
